title: Outcomes of bariatric surgery at the Bundeswehrkrankenhaus Berlin (German Armed Forces Hospital Berlin) - a retrospective cohort study
summary:
This study evaluates the outcomes of bariatric surgery (sleeve gastrectomy) performed at the Bundeswehrkrankenhaus (German Armed Forces Hospital) Berlin. Existing medical records from patients who underwent surgery in previous years are analyzed retrospectively. No additional examinations or interventions are carried out, and participation does not involve any risk or burden for patients.
The study aims to assess weight loss, changes in obesity-related conditions such as diabetes or hypertension, and the occurrence of complications after surgery. In military personnel, changes in physical fitness after surgery are also evaluated.
The results are intended to support evidence-based treatment decisions and to better understand the role of bariatric surgery in a military medical setting. All data are analyzed anonymously in accordance with data protection regulations.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of all patients with obesity undergoing laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy at Bundeswehrkrankenhaus (German Armed Forces Hospital) Berlin between 2014 and 2024.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- bariatric laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (OPS-Code 5-434.50)
- age >/= 18 years
- all insurances
- minimum 12 months of follow-up
- subgroup: soldiers and similar professions (police, fire fighters)
Exclusion criteria:
Failure to meet the inclusion criteria.
Active patient objection (opt-out procedure announced by study information displayed at BWK Berlin).
